While ‘Mercs’ is a catch-all term nowadays for anyone that gets paid to shoot, there does exist some baseline for what most consider a ‘professional.’ That’s what these are; experienced, kitted out killers-for-hire with a wide array of fighting styles.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Mercs).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.
Standard Kevlar for your head. No armor penalty.
Light version of an Armorjack. No armor penalty.
Provides immunity to inhalable gases or fumes.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive) ♦ Install: Clinic

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)

Run the edge at top speed, choomba. There ain’t another way to live.

Speedware. As an Action, the user may activate this cyberware, after which it remains active for the next 60 seconds (20 Rounds). While active, this cyberware provides a +3 bonus to any Initiative Roll made. If activated while the user is already in an Initiative Queue, their current Initiative increases by 3, which is lost if this cyberware deactivates or its duration expires during combat. This cyberware has a 1 hour cooldown before it can be activated again. Only 1 piece of Speedware can be installed at a time.

Type: Neuralware
Install: Clinic
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • Replaces the core system's Sandevistan; use this one instead of the core item.
  • Matches the core item's setup: the +3 shows as a toggle in the initiative roll dialog.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Neuralware).
